title: What retrieve returns and what bounds it
trigger: When calling the DD retrieve/orient tools, or changing how retrieval selects and sizes memories
behavior_delta: Expect at most 8 pushed memories within budget_tokens (800 by default), counted as the agent reads them. Each arrives in its most compact form that fits, down to a one-line headline with the id to fetch. Up to 8 more arrive as pointers (topic_key, when it applies, get id) on prompts and tool calls, once per session; get one when its line applies. Candidates come from FTS plus, with the resident, nearest embeddings. An explicit retrieve returns its fused top 5 even below their floors, and a non-English prompt asks for a retrieve in English. vpt_threshold is a floor on marginal value, not a per-token ratio.
what: Expect at most 8 pushed memories within budget_tokens (800 by default), counted as the agent reads them. Each arrives in its most compact form that fits, down to a one-line headline with the id to fetch. Up to 8 more arrive as pointers (topic_key, when it applies, get id) on prompts and tool calls, once per session; get one when its line applies. Candidates come from FTS plus, with the resident, nearest embeddings. An explicit retrieve returns its fused top 5 even below their floors, and a non-English prompt asks for a retrieve in English. vpt_threshold is a floor on marginal value, not a per-token ratio.
why: Measured 2026-09-22: the old value-per-token gate capped every memory near 50 tokens, so reviewed advice longer than a sentence never injected; one ~470-token micro form filled the pack alone. The headline fallback and the value floor fixed both, verified by tests/engine/cognition/retrieval-reach.test.js and the task benchmark. Revised for 0.8.0 (2026-09-29): pull-first delivery (pointers on tool calls, explicit retrieve, English-retrieve nudge) reached 0.90-0.96 must-recall on the golden sets' measuring halves with bench:pull, and the budget now counts the rendered pack.
